# Ezekiel 37 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-hand-of YHWH was upon-me, and-He-brought-me-out in-the-Spirit-of YHWH and-set-me-down in-the-midst-of the-valley; and-it [was] full-of bones.

**2** And-He-caused-me-to-pass over-them all-around, and-behold, very many [were] on-the-surface-of the-valley, and-behold, [they-were] very dry.

**3** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of-man, can-these-bones live?" And-I-said, "Lord YHWH, You know."

**4** And-He-said to-me, "Prophesy over these bones and-say to-them: Dry bones, hear the-word-of YHWH!

**5** Thus says the-Lord YHWH to-these bones: Behold-Me bringing into-you breath, and-you-will-live.

**6** And-I-will-put upon-you sinews and-bring-up upon-you flesh and-spread over-you skin and-put in-you breath, and-you-will-live; and-you-will-know that I [am] YHWH."

**7** And-I-prophesied as I-was-commanded; and-there-was a-sound as-I-prophesied, and-behold — a-rattling! And-the-bones came-together, bone to its-bone.

**8** And-I-looked, and-behold — upon-them sinews, and-flesh came-up, and-skin spread over-them from-above; but-breath [was] not in-them.

**9** And-He-said to-me, "Prophesy to the-breath; prophesy, son-of-man, and-say to the-breath: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: From-the-four winds come, breath, and-breathe into-these slain, and-they-will-live."

**10** And-I-prophesied as He-commanded-me, and-the-breath came into-them, and-they-lived and-stood upon-their-feet — an-army great, very, very.

**11** And-He-said to-me, "Son-of-man, these bones — they [are] the-whole house-of Israel. Behold, they say, 'Our-bones are-dried-up and-our-hope is-lost; we-are-cut-off.'

**12** Therefore prophesy and-say to-them: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Behold-Me opening your-graves and-bringing-you-up from-your-graves, My-people, and-I-will-bring-you to the-land-of Israel.

**13** And-you-will-know that I [am] YHWH when-I-open your-graves and-when-I-bring-you-up from-your-graves, My-people.

**14** And-I-will-put My-Spirit in-you and-you-will-live, and-I-will-settle-you on your-own-land; and-you-will-know that I, YHWH, have-spoken and-have-done-[it],'" declares YHWH.

**15** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**16** "And-you, son-of-man, take for-yourself one stick and-write upon-it, 'For-Judah and-for-the-sons-of Israel his-companions.' And-take one stick and-write upon-it, 'For-Joseph — the-stick-of Ephraim — and-all the-house-of Israel his-companions.'

**17** And-bring-them-near one to the-other for-you, into-one stick, and-they-will-become one in-your-hand.

**18** And-when the-sons-of your-people say to-you, saying, 'Will-you-not-tell-us what these [are] to-you?'

**19** Say to-them, Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Behold-Me taking the-stick-of Joseph which [is] in-the-hand-of Ephraim, and-the-tribes-of Israel his-companions, and-I-will-put-them upon-it — upon the-stick-of Judah — and-make-them one stick, and-they-will-be one in-My-hand.'

**20** And-the-sticks on-which you-write will-be in-your-hand before-their-eyes.

**21** And-say to-them: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Behold-Me taking the-sons-of Israel from-among the-nations where they-have-gone, and-I-will-gather-them from-every-side and-bring-them to their-own-land.

**22** And-I-will-make-them one nation in-the-land, on the-mountains-of Israel; and-one king will-be king for-all-of-them, and-they-will-not-be-again two nations, and-they-will-not-be-divided-again into-two kingdoms anymore.

**23** And-they-will-not-defile-themselves anymore with-their-idols and-with-their-detestable-things and-with-all their-transgressions; and-I-will-save-them from-all their-dwelling-places in-which they-sinned, and-I-will-cleanse-them; and-they-will-be to-Me a-people, and-I will-be to-them God.

**24** And-My-servant David [will-be] king over-them, and-one shepherd will-be for-all-of-them; and-in-My-judgments they-will-walk and-My-statutes they-will-keep and-do-them.

**25** And-they-will-dwell on the-land which I-gave to My-servant, to-Jacob, in-which your-fathers dwelt; and-they-will-dwell upon-it — they and-their-sons and-their-sons'-sons forever; and-David My-servant [will-be] prince to-them forever.

**26** And-I-will-make for-them a-covenant-of peace; an-everlasting-covenant it-will-be with-them; and-I-will-place-them and-multiply-them and-put My-sanctuary in-their-midst forever.

**27** And-My-dwelling-place will-be over-them, and-I-will-be to-them God, and-they will-be to-Me a-people.

**28** And-the-nations will-know that I [am] YHWH who-sanctifies Israel, when-My-sanctuary is in-their-midst forever."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **37:1-2**: Beqa — 'valley' (or plain). The bones are described as yeveishot me'od — 'very dry,' emphasizing complete death beyond any natural recovery. This is not recent death but ancient desolation.

- **37:9**: Ruach here carries its full semantic range: 'wind,' 'breath,' 'spirit.' The command to prophesy to the ruach from the arba ruchot ('four winds') creates a deliberate wordplay connecting weather, respiration, and divine power.

- **37:26**: Berit shalom, berit olam — 'covenant of peace, everlasting covenant.' This is the culmination of Ezekiel's restoration theology: permanent peace sealed by God's own sanctuary dwelling among His people.

— EMET
